Container.Name: ebook-convert-sidecar
Container.Overview:
Converts the books in your library folder to extra formats with Calibre's ebook-convert and saves them next to the original (Title.epub -> Title.azw3). Library apps that treat same-named files in one folder as one book, such as Grimmory and BookOrbit, then show the new file as an extra format of the existing book.
Starts in dry-run mode: check the log for what it would create, then set Dry Run to false. When a source changes later (e.g. your library app writes edited metadata into the EPUB), the converted file is made again. Files it did not create itself are never touched. Optional Calibre plugins can be added through the plugins folder.
Container.Requires: A library app that treats same-named files in one folder as one book (e.g. Grimmory or BookOrbit, not in "book per file" mode) and notices new files through folder watching or a scheduled scan.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The same share your library app uses. Converted files are written next to the originals.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Keeps state.json: which files this tool created and which conversions failed. Don't delete it, or converted files are no longer kept in sync.

Config.Name: Calibre plugins
Config.Description: Optional. Calibre plugin .zip files (and their settings .json) to install on every start. Restart the container after adding or removing one.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: true: only log what would be converted. false: actually convert.

Config.Name: Target Formats
Config.Description: Comma-separated formats to create, e.g. azw3,mobi,pdf. Use formats your library app can read.

Config.Name: Source Formats
Config.Description: Comma-separated formats to convert from, in order of preference when a book has several.

Config.Name: Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes between runs. 0 runs once and stops the container; start it again to re-run.

Config.Name: Max per run
Config.Description: Stop after this many conversions per run (0 = no limit). Handy for a first test.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files it writes. Use the same as your library app (BookOrbit's default is 1000).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files it writes. Use the same as your library app (BookOrbit's default is 1000).

Config.Name: Extra ebook-convert arguments
Config.Description: Passed to every ebook-convert call, e.g. --output-profile kindle_pw3

Config.Name: Ignore files
Config.Description: Comma-separated file names; a folder containing one of them is skipped.

Config.Name: Timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: Give up on a single conversion after this long.
